1. (Judgment 4) At 1440 the stack, attribution and deck run past 900px. The deck "You will be very, very glad that you did." is cut by the bottom edge after "glad that". Tighten the vertical spacing in the stack and the gap above the attribution so the whole quote, deck included, lands inside the first fold.

2. (Judgment 6) The Header Declaration puts the numbered nav (01 Work 02 About 03 Contact) along the lower edge of the jade field. At 1440 no nav is visible in the first fold, so a desktop visitor gets no navigation. Pin the row to the bottom of the 100vh field so it shows at 900px, as it already does at 360.

3. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman card's copy is not in the records:
   - "The hardest problems don't announce themselves — you find them by shipping. Spaceman was…"
   - "…years of doing exactly that: building the product, the brand, and the stubborn thing in the middle, in public, and finding out what held."

   Replace it with the record's text. That is the LLC he has operated under for the past decade, partnering with companies and studios across product design, frontend engineering, design systems and brand. It is still the vehicle for independent work and new experiments.

4. (Judgment 5) The role line under the wordmark reads "DESIGN · ENGINEERING". The record's role is "Product Designer & Developer". Set the role line to the recorded role.

5. (Judgment 6) SHELL declares `ground_material: dots`, a faint gold dot field on the jade. The hero field renders as flat colour at both widths. Make the dot field visible on the hero field without crossing the stacked words.

Neither the 1440 image nor fold 1 at 360 shows any dots: the jade hero field is flat colour. Lay the faint gold dot pattern across the hero field, kept subtle enough that the stacked imperative and the deck read clear of it.
